text: Close the gaps that let job 20261014-174815-7bf8 land a steward that never calls a model. Its request cited a BRIEF.md addendum, but the verifier judged only the reading's criteria and never compared the change with that addendum; and the job moved its own requirement rows A9-1 and A10-1 to covered, which nobody checked independently. When a request cites a document, the verifier must check the change against it, and falling short of it counts as a request-reading mismatch. A job may not mark its own requirement rows covered. Put A9-1 and A10-1 back to partial with the reason.
